items.title: Building an AI-ready design system library: Code → Figma with MCP
items.excerpt: A practical guide for designers on starting the design system in code and using MCP to build, check and maintain the Figma library so AI agents can work from it. Part 1 of a three-part series that continues into AI prototyping inside the design system.

items.title: Nobody asked for the sparkle button
items.excerpt: Products keep shipping the same sparkle-icon AI panel while users hunt for the off switch and spend outruns returns. The piece argues teams should build features with AI, not AI features.

items.title: Where to draw the line before AI reaches professional users
items.excerpt: Nearly every B2B roadmap now has a chat box on it. Six questions for deciding whether a conversational AI layer will speed experts up or put a keyboard between them and work they already know.

items.title: Just Eat's AI apocalypse might be the most disastrous slop show yet
items.excerpt: Just Eat's AI-generated menu food imagery produced 'tiger' prawns and a literal toad in the hole, and the delivery app paused it. Creative Bloq asks what the episode says about replacing food photography with generative images.

items.title: New CG software you may have missed: 25 October 2026
items.excerpt: CG Channel's weekly roundup of new CG tools includes Animatica's Choreographer, which uses AI to generate motion between key poses, and a real-time AI renderer from Vast AI Research's Project Eden world model, alongside texturing apps and a Blender add-on.

items.title: Document Crunch adds AI review for construction drawings
items.excerpt: CrunchAI compares drawings, contracts and specifications to flag scope gaps and conflicting requirements before construction begins.

items.title: Siemens, NVIDIA develop AI workflow for PCB inspection
items.excerpt: Siemens and NVIDIA's process uses digital twins and synthetic defect images to train automated optical inspection systems before physical boards enter production.

items.title: Better Prompts, Better Project Outcomes: Using Autodesk Assistant in Forma
items.excerpt: From an Autodesk University 2026 session with CIMA+'s BIM manager: how prompting Autodesk Assistant inside Forma helps architects and engineers move from early-stage site and massing questions to project outcomes.

items.title: I Compared 11 Best AI Design-to-Code Tools for My Client Projects
items.excerpt: A hands-on comparison of 11 AI design-to-code tools, from Figma integrations to AI coding agents, and how to choose one for turning designs into production code.

items.title: Fixing text in an AI-generated image is an inpainting problem, not a prompt problem
items.excerpt: If the picture is right and one word is wrong, don't regenerate: remove the glyphs, inpaint the background and re-set the type. A practical workflow for fixing text in AI-generated images.

items.title: The New Full-Stack Designer
items.excerpt: On YC's Design Review, Shopify product design studio lead Marvin Schwaibold walks through how his design process has changed with AI coding tools, the admin redesign and Sidekick work his team shipped, and why taste is now the bottleneck.

items.title: Config India 2026: When everyone can make anything, how far can we take it?
items.excerpt: teamLab co-founder Daisuke Sakai asks what matters once AI lets everyone generate images, build software and ship products instantly, and argues human discernment matters more than ever.

items.title: 로고 생성 넘어 SVG 편집 파일로...이디오그램, 벡터 AI로 디자인 실무 공략
items.excerpt: Ideogram has moved from generating logo and illustration images to outputting editable SVG vector files, pitching its vector AI at real design production work rather than finished-looking pictures.

items.title: Google Unveils Gemini That Remembers Brand Style
items.excerpt: Gemini can now remember a brand's style: register a website, brand kit, fonts and colors once and generate new on-brand images without re-uploading guidelines each time.

items.title: Adobe pushes 'commercially safe' AI graphics, says to indemnify if clients get sued
items.excerpt: Adobe is pitching its AI graphics as 'commercially safe', warning that generic tools may expose enterprises to copyright infringement and saying it will indemnify clients who get sued.

items.title: Grok Imagine Delivers First Seven Minutes of Its Odyssey Series
items.excerpt: Grok Imagine posted the opening seven-minute installment of an AI-generated Odyssey series made with Wonder Studios and director Dev Walker.

items.title: MOSS-Image: The Open-Source Model Teaching AI to Spell
items.excerpt: MOSS-Image is a 5B open-source image model that renders readable bilingual text and JSON-specified layouts, scoring 96.3 on long-text rendering benchmarks.

items.title: ByteDance's Seedance Tops AI Video Quality Rankings
items.excerpt: A University of Hong Kong study of 12 AI video models ranked ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 Pro first for visual quality, with Chinese models beating US rivals on quality but lagging on safeguards.

items.title: AMAXiMAL releases TopMod 3D v3 for AI-assisted 3D modeling
items.excerpt: TopMod 3D v3 is a free, open-source modeling tool with AI-assisted design, complex-geometry and topology tools, and Rhino 8 integration.

items.title: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
items.excerpt: Pennsylvania's AI Deceptive Advertising Act will require disclosure labels on ads made with generative AI, though the law leaves a lot of loopholes.

items.title: Blue Planet III is keeping the rough edges in the age of AI
items.excerpt: The BBC's Blue Planet III is keeping shots that would normally hit the cutting-room floor, using visible imperfection to prove its footage is real as AI video spreads.

items.title: Total War studio says they are 'investigating' the AI-botched Shogun 2 remaster
items.excerpt: Sega pulled the Shogun 2 Complete Edition after players found bugs and texture upscaling that appeared to be done by AI; Creative Assembly says it is investigating the external developer's work.

items.title: Why Flawless Retouching Now Looks Like AI
items.excerpt: Over-edited portraits now read as AI output; Prince Meyson on how photographers can prove their work is real through process, imperfections and in-camera technique.

items.title: ElevenLabs debuts AI tool that auto-scores videos with music and effects
items.excerpt: ElevenLabs launched Instant Soundtrack, which analyzes a video and generates matching music and sound effects in one pass for creators and editors.
